insights: The Pricing Page has the best performance, with a load time of 183.8 ms, indicating that the page's resources are optimized and efficient.

The Blog Page has a faster first contentful paint (FCP) time of 230.9 ms compared to the Homepage's FCP time of 645.8 ms, suggesting that the Blog Page's above-the-fold content is loading faster than the Homepage's.

The How It Works Page's failure indicates that there might be issues with the page's resources or code that need to be addressed to improve its performance. It is recommended to prioritize investigating and optimizing this page to ensure a good user experience.
